questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she (have) _____ seen the film before.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I am sure he will come,' she said. -> She said that _____ he would come.

Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb: If I _____ you, I would take that job.

Options:

A) was
B) were
C) had been
D) am

Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice? 

Options:

A) The letter was written by me.
B) By me was the letter written.
C) Me wrote the letter.
D) The letter I wrote.
options: The letter was written by me.
By me was the letter written.
questions.answer: The letter was written by me.

questions.question:
Choose the correct collocation: She was very _____ about her work.

Options:

A) keen
B) enthusiastic
C) passionate
D) eager

Select the correct dependent preposition: We decided _____ postpone the meeting until next week.

Options:

A) to
B) for
C) on
D) with

Which word best completes the sentence: 'I'm afraid I can't help you with that. It's not really _____ my area of expertise.'

Options:

A) in
B) within
C) on
D) about

Choose the correct form to complete the sentence: If only I _____ the opportunity to study abroad last year!

Options:

A) had had
B) had
C) have had
D) would have

Select the appropriate discourse marker for the following context: 'I think I might have left my keys at home. _____, can you wait for a few minutes while I go back?' 

Options:

A) Therefore
B) However
C) Meanwhile
D) Moreover

Which sentence correctly uses the third conditional structure? 

Options:

A) If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
B) If I study harder, I will pass the exam.
C) If I had studied harder, I would study.
D) If I studied harder, I would have passed.
options: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I study harder, I will pass the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would study.
If I studied harder, I would have passed.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
